summary.zh: agent-pack 新增作用域声明：Project Profile 的 capabilities.default_scope / mcp_scope / skill_scope 与 sync、reconcile 的 --scope。声明为 project 的条目不再写入用户级（本版跳过并警告，项目级写入随后续版本提供），预览按作用域分组并给出收窄影响；不写新键时行为与输出不变。
summary.en: agent-pack adds scope declaration: the Project Profile keys capabilities.default_scope / mcp_scope / skill_scope and --scope on sync and reconcile. Entries declared project-level are no longer written to the user level (skipped with a warning for now; project-level writes follow in later releases), the preview is grouped by scope and shows the narrowing impact; without the new keys behavior and output are unchanged.
